> @copilot Unable to preload CSS for https://objectui-components-git-copilot-add-stories-751319-object-stack.vercel.app/assets/preview-BblJuEE8.css
> The component failed to render properly, likely due to...

Fixed in commit 8dda86b. 

**Root cause**: Plugin packages weren't imported in Storybook, causing component registration and CSS loading failures.

**Solution**: Added Vite aliases in `.storybook/main.ts` to resolve plugin packages from source during build, avoiding circular dependencies with `@object-ui/components`.

**Verification**: Storybook now builds successfully and all plugin components render correctly.
